lesson.subtitle: Lesson 7 -- Dinner for Two
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Bruna Defrain | Lesson 7 -- Dinner for Two

listenings.text: Good evening, and welcome to Rossi's, an Italian restaurant in London. Tonight we have two specials. Pasta with tomato is eighteen pounds. Fish with potatoes is twenty-four pounds. A glass of red wine is nine pounds. And for dessert, ask your waiter. Enjoy your dinner!

Hi, Bruna, it is Emma, from the hotel. Your table for tonight is at Rossi's, on King Street. It is ten minutes from the hotel. The food is Italian, and the prices are good: dinner for two is about sixty pounds. Your table is at eight. Enjoy!

extra_audio.text: Bruna asks for a table for two. The waiter brings two menus. She asks: how much is the fish? She orders two glasses of white wine. At the end, she asks for the check.

lesson.grammar_point: plural nouns (-s / -es) + How much is it? with numbers 20-100
